objective: Test whether the frozen defined-risk short-put-spread structure clears the canonical overfit gate when entries are additionally filtered by the point-in-time Qlib per-asset bullish signal, over the wider v2 ETF universe.

motivation.gap_in_v1: options_etf_gate_v1 deliberately omitted the Qlib filter because no point-in-time per-asset history existed. Under that purely global rule every symbol entered on identical dates (pairwise Jaccard of entry-date sets = 1.0), so pooled n=369 collapsed to 41 cluster observations and cluster_adjusted equalled spy_only.
motivation.what_changed: qlib_lab.score_history now exports a walk-forward, no-lookahead per-asset score/lean/conviction history (2019-07-18 onward), so the live filter can be replayed honestly.
motivation.measured_expectation: The qlib_evidence diagnostic (journal/scorecards/qlib_evidence.json) measured 36 independent entry dates without the filter versus 192 with it (mean 1.6 symbols per entry date, Jaccard 0.0168). The filter is expected to REDUCE trade count (1116 -> 307) while RAISING independent observations.

hypothesis: Qlib's cross-sectional lean decorrelates entry timing enough to make the gate decidable, and the selected subset performs at least as well per trade as the unfiltered population.

scope.mode: offline research; SHADOW advisory only; no broker integration
scope.structures_excluded: call spread and iron condor are NOT evaluated here: the filter admits only bullish lean, so only the put spread is reachable. They require their own pre-registration.
scope.window: bounded by the score export (2019-07-18 onward); shorter than v1's price history and stated in the scorecard
scope.price_source: local qlib_lab/csv/<asset>.csv, Yahoo back-adjustment undone via the factor column

global_veto.note: unchanged from v1 and the live lane

qlib_filter.semantics: lean is a CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK over the 76-asset model universe: top-TOPK(8) score +1. Selectivity is structural, not a tuned threshold.
qlib_filter.no_lookahead: refit every 126 sessions on labels fully realized before the refit date (cutoff = dates[i - horizon]); models applied forward only

entry_policy.contracts: identical to options_etf_gate_v1: monthly third-Friday nearest 45 DTE within 30-60, short put at -0.30 delta, long put exactly spread_width lower
entry_policy.settlement: hold to expiration at intrinsic value (canonical; no take-profit, stop-loss, or DTE exit)
entry_policy.non_overlap: one open position per symbol; a new entry is refused until the prior expiry has passed

carried_over_deviations.deviation: implied volatility is proxied, not observed
carried_over_deviations.consequence: the per-asset IV/RV test still degenerates to a market-wide condition; unchanged from v1 and never presented as observed IV

carried_over_deviations.deviation: model credit instead of natural bid/ask credit
carried_over_deviations.consequence: entry pricing is optimistic relative to live execution; measured edge is an upper bound

independence_and_inference.required_handling: cluster same-date entries into one observation (mean PnL), identical to v1
independence_and_inference.why_it_matters_here: The whole point of this experiment is that clustering should now cost far less than it did in v1, because entries are staggered rather than simultaneous. If cluster_adjusted n does not rise well above 41, the filter did NOT add evidence and this must be reported as a negative result.

trial_accounting.composition: 31 symbol hypotheses in this experiment plus the 9 already spent in options_etf_gate_v1; deflation must pay for every look taken on this family, not just the current run.
trial_accounting.no_threshold_softening: Canonical thresholds fixed: PBO < 0.5 AND Deflated Sharpe > 0. A higher trade count does not lower the bar, and a high raw profit factor never overrides a failed DSR.

falsifiable_predictions: PBO is computable rather than unavailable
if the Qlib filter carries genuine information, per-trade mean PnL of the filtered set is >= the unfiltered v1 population
promotion: No promotion. A pass changes only a display badge. Live promotion additionally requires natural-pricing confirmation, live-quote liquidity validation, and human review.
